method: API-surface sweep (grep, not call-graph first) over the extract of 3375aadb at scratchpad\main2. Step 1: identified the only project referencing Autodesk assemblies: src/RackCad.Plugin/RackCad.Plugin.csproj:11-16,28-39 (AcCoreMgd/AcDbMgd/AcMgd or AutoCAD.NET NuGet); grep for 'Autodesk.' in src/RackCad.UI, src/RackCad.Application, src/RackCad.Domain returned no source hits; tests contain 'using Autodesk' only as a string literal (tests/RackCad.Tests/CustomPropertiesEdgeGuardTests.cs:156). Step 2: grep of all 69 Plugin .cs files (10,952 lines) for AppendEntity, AddNewlyCreatedDBObject, SetAt, Erase(, UpgradeOpen/DowngradeOpen, OpenMode.ForWrite, CreateExtensionDictionary, new Xrecord/.Data=, XData/ResultBuffer, RecordGraphicsModified, WblockCloneObjects, DeepCloneObjects, Wblock/Insert(, Purge(, new Database(, ReadDwgFile, SaveAs, StartTransaction, StartOpenCloseTransaction, Commit/Abort, LockDocument, Regen/UpdateScreen/SetCurrentView, AdjustAlignment, RecomputeDimensionBlock, TransformBy, SetDatabaseDefaults, constructors (BlockReference, BlockTableRecord, DBText, RotatedDimension, LayerTableRecord, Polyline, Circle, IdMapping), and property setters (Layer/LayerId/Color/ColorIndex/Linetype/LineWeight/Position/ScaleFactors/Rotation/Normal/TextString/Height/AlignmentPoint/Dim*/Name/Origin/Closed). Step 3: every hit was read in context and classified REACHED (by Selective frontal/planta creation, reference placement or library import) or NOT REACHED, with the chain proven by reading callers (grep of caller names). Chain abbreviations used in reached_by: ENTRY = RACKSELECTIVO (RackSelectivoCommands.cs:26-39) | RACKCAD menu SelectiveInsertionRequest (RackMenuCommands.cs:76-78) | RACKEDITAR->SelectiveKindHandler.Edit (KindHandlers/SelectiveKindHandler.cs:19-20)->EditSelective 'Insertar' branch (RackSelectivoCommands.cs:270-280); CH-F = ENTRY -> DrawSelectiveView (RackSelectivoCommands.cs:429-432) -> DrawSelectiveViewFromAuthored (:449-476) -> InsertSelectiveFrontal (:484-523) -> SelectiveFrontalDrawService.DrawAndPlace (Systems/Selective/SelectiveFrontalDrawService.cs:31-39) -> ViewBlockDraw.DrawAndPlace (Systems/Shared/ViewBlockDraw.cs:28-57); CH-P = ENTRY -> DrawSelectiveViewFromAuthored (:467-473) -> SelectivePlantaDrawService.DrawAndPlace (Systems/Selective/SelectivePlantaDrawService.cs:26-34) -> ViewBlockDraw.DrawAndPlace; CREATE = ViewBlockDraw.cs:50 -> SystemBlockWriter.CreateBlock (Systems/Shared/SystemBlockWriter.cs:18-40); PLACE = ViewBlockDraw.cs:51 -> BlockPlacement.PlaceAndReport (Drawing/BlockPlacement.cs:26-53) -> PlaceBlockWithJig (:174-201); IMPORT = SystemBlockWriter.cs:25 -> BlockLibraryImporter.EnsureForPlan (Drawing/BlockLibraryImporter.cs:25-38) -> LibraryBlockAvailabilityFlow.Observe (src/RackCad.Application/Systems/Shared/LibraryBlockRequirements.cs:158-180: Ensure first, then Query) -> ImportAdapter.Ensure (BlockLibraryImporter.cs:140-141) -> EnsureRequirements (:42-47) -> EnsureBlocks (:50-132). All paths are relative to the extract root. Only files inside the extract were read.

entry_points.name: RACKSELECTIVO / alias RS (creation of ONE view per invocation: frontal of one fondo, planta, or lateral)
RACKCAD / alias RK main menu, SelectiveInsertionRequest case
RACKEDITAR / alias RED -> SelectiveKindHandler.Edit -> EditSelective 'Insertar' (non-UpdateOnly) branch -> DrawSelectiveViewFromAuthored
DrawSelectiveView / DrawSelectiveViewFromAuthored (internal dispatch by view: lateral :461-465, planta :467-473, frontal :475)

contract_required_operations.description: SL-1/SL-2 must create the view definition inside a caller-supplied (Database, Transaction). Current CreateBlock takes a Document, opens its own lock L1 (SystemBlockWriter.cs:23), its own T1 (:27) and commits (:36). LateralHeaderDrawer.CreateSystemBlock (LateralHeaderDrawer.cs:28-81) already takes (Database, Transaction) and does not commit/lock, so it is the reusable core; the wrapper is what violates the clause. AUTH-15 RackDefinitionCreator.CreateInTransaction (Systems/Shared/RackDefinitionCreator.cs:39-80) is a caller-owned header-run creator but has NO product caller at this SHA (grep: only its definition and tests/RackCad.Tests/RackDefinitionCreatorGuardTests.cs).
contract_required_operations.basis: Clause: receive caller Database and Transaction; NO internal Commit, Abort, Dispose of caller transaction, LockDocument

contract_required_operations.description: SL-4 must append the model-space reference inside T_M. Current placement opens its own lock L2 and T2 and commits (BlockPlacement.cs:179-198); BlockPlacement.AppendReference (BlockPlacement.cs:79-95) is non-interactive but also owns lock+tx+commit. No caller-owned BlockReference placement exists for Selective; the only caller-owned fixed-point placement is CantileverViewMaterializer.InsertReference (Drawing/Cantilever/CantileverViewMaterializer.cs:118-130), which sets Position only.
contract_required_operations.basis: Clause: receive caller Database and Transaction; NO internal Commit/LockDocument; place the block reference in the caller's transaction

contract_required_operations.description: Verify the passed transaction is the live top transaction of the target database before any write. Only AUTH-15 Precheck does this (RackDefinitionCreator.cs:147-164, comparing TopTransaction.UnmanagedObject; OpenCloseTransaction deliberately unsupported). CreateSystemBlock, SystemBlockWriter.RedefineInTransaction (SystemBlockWriter.cs:104-116) and every placement path perform no such check. SL-4 needs its own check (none exists for placement).
contract_required_operations.basis: Clause: verify the transaction is the live top transaction

contract_required_operations.description: Create, for one logical rack, frontal definition k for EVERY fondo k plus the planta definition, each with one model-space reference, all in ONE T_M. Current product creates ONE view per invocation (RackSelectivoCommands.cs:461-475), picks the fondo interactively via editor.GetInteger (:495-515), and splits each view into T1 (definition, committed) + T2 (reference, committed). fondoCount from SelectiveDepthLayout.Count(system) (:493) and per-fondo system from SelectiveDepthLayout.FondoSystemView (:517) are the reusable inputs.
contract_required_operations.basis: Contract preamble: all frontal definitions (one per fondo k) and the planta definition, each with ONE block reference, entirely inside ONE caller-owned T_M

contract_required_operations.description: SL-4 must set Position, ScaleFactors, Rotation and Normal from a computed transform with no jig/interaction. Current code: jig only, only Position set (BlockPlacement.cs:182-184, 242). No '.Normal =' setter or BlockTransform/TransformBy on an entity exists anywhere in the Plugin (property-setter grep; TransformBy only on a Vector3d displacement at RackDuplicarCommands.cs:147).
contract_required_operations.basis: Clause SL-4: place from a computed transform (no jig, no interaction), set position/scale/rotation/normal from the transform

contract_required_operations.description: Reject transforms with non-positive determinant / any negative scale for the placed reference. No placement path checks this. Pure helpers exist in Application (src/RackCad.Application/Geometry/Transform2D.cs:77-83 Determinant/ReversesOrientation; src/RackCad.Application/Systems/Shared/RackTransformFacts.cs:21-34,97-98) but are not used by any placement.
contract_required_operations.basis: Clause SL-4: strictly positive determinant, no negative scale

contract_required_operations.description: Set layer and entity properties of the placed reference from the plan. Current PlaceBlockWithJig sets no Layer/LayerId/Color/Linetype/LineWeight and calls no SetDatabaseDefaults (BlockPlacement.cs:174-201); effective layer at runtime is decided by AutoCAD (UNCERTAIN from code).
contract_required_operations.basis: Clause SL-4: set layer and properties from the plan

contract_required_operations.description: Apply dynamic properties and RecordGraphicsModified to the PLACED reference inside T_M. Current creation applies them only to nested piece references inside the definition (LateralHeaderDrawer.cs:319, 415-449); the top-level definition is a plain BlockTableRecord{Name, Origin} (LateralHeaderDrawer.cs:243) and PlaceBlockWithJig never calls RecordGraphicsModified. The redraw precedent calls RecordGraphicsModified on references inside the caller's transaction (LateralHeaderDrawer.cs:167-171).
contract_required_operations.basis: Clause SL-4: apply dynamic properties and RecordGraphicsModified INSIDE T_M

contract_required_operations.description: Remove post-commit graphics/cleanup writes and compensating erase. The creation chain performs no Regen (ApplyRegen not called on ViewBlockDraw.DrawAndPlace/CreateBlock/PlaceAndReport), but the cancel path does post-commit Erase + Purge (BlockPlacement.cs:37-42, 123-170; LateralHeaderDrawer.cs:193-238). Under T_M a failure must be an abort by the caller, not a cleanup by the seam.
contract_required_operations.basis: Clause SL-4: no post-commit graphics writes; general: a failed call leaves the caller obliged to abort

contract_required_operations.description: Write the caller-composed envelope verbatim, then read it back and compare. Current CreateBlock writes via RackBlockData.Write with no read-back (SystemBlockWriter.cs:31-34) and silently writes nothing when payload is null/empty (SystemBlockWriter.cs:31; RackBlockData.cs:22-25; WrapSelectivePayload returns null on empty design, RackSelectivoCommands.cs:408-411). AUTH-15 has the read-back (RackDefinitionCreator.cs:201-214) but takes a RackEmbedDocument and re-serializes it (:185-187) and at this SHA refuses an envelope with blank Name (:177-183), whereas the Selective product allows a blank rack name (fallback block name 'Selectivo', RackSelectivoCommands.cs:520; default names RackViewBaseName.cs:22-37) and composes the envelope with the name as given (:413-416). Reconciling blank-name handling is required before reuse (UNCERTAIN how the seam will resolve it).
contract_required_operations.basis: Clause: envelope composed by the caller and written verbatim, then read back and compared

contract_required_operations.description: Mint NewRackId once per logical rack in the orchestrator and assert it is identical in every sibling envelope (all frontals k and planta). Current Plugin never mints a Selective id: it is minted in the UI (RackEditorSession.cs:126 -> RackEditorIdentity.EnsureId :45-48) or taken from the picked embed (RackSelectivoCommands.cs:120) and passed to a single-view creation. No cross-envelope equality check exists.
contract_required_operations.seam_role: Orchestrator (SL-1/SL-2 receive it inside the envelope)
contract_required_operations.basis: Clause: NewRackId minted once per logical rack by the orchestrator and identical in every sibling envelope

contract_required_operations.description: Compute effective block names deterministically and expose them. Base names are pure (RackViewBaseName.cs:22-37,186-191), but the effective name (SanitizeBlockName + '_N' collision suffix) is decided INSIDE the write by probing the live BlockTable (LateralHeaderDrawer.cs:240-247, 395-413), so it depends on in-transaction state and on sibling creation order; nested group names (SEL_FRONTAL_*, PLANTA_CAB_*) are also uniquified inside and not returned (only the system name is returned, LateralHeaderDrawer.cs:54,80). An empty effective name is possible (BlockNaming.SanitizeBlockName returns trimmed cleaned text, src/RackCad.Application/BlockNaming.cs:12-29; AUTH-15 guards it, RackDefinitionCreator.cs:57-63,121-131).
contract_required_operations.basis: Clause: effective block names computed deterministically

contract_required_operations.description: Seams must not import. Current CreateBlock imports inside its own lock right before T1 (SystemBlockWriter.cs:25). The PREPARE pattern that separates import from the mutation exists for redraw only (ViewBlockDraw.PrepareRedraw, ViewBlockDraw.cs:65-89; used by ProjectVariableMutationExecutor.cs:239-257). A create-side PREPARE for Selective frontal/planta does not exist.
contract_required_operations.basis: Clause: seams do not import (imports belong to SL-5)

contract_required_operations.description: SL-5 must return a structured result. Current EnsureForPlan returns int ImportedCount only (BlockLibraryImporter.cs:25-38), discards the post-import availability facts computed by LibraryBlockAvailabilityFlow (LibraryBlockRequirements.cs:175-179), returns 0 for file missing / unreadable / exception without distinction (BlockLibraryImporter.cs:87-91, 96-100, 126-131), reports ids.Count requested rather than verified (:123-124), and ImportAdapter always reports WasAttempted=true (:140-141).
contract_required_operations.basis: Clause SL-5: PREPARE-W library import with a structured result

contract_required_operations.description: SL-5 must read ONLY an already-opened library Database of a private copy. Current importer resolves the configured path itself (BlockLibraryLocator.ResolvePath, src/RackCad.Application/Catalogs/BlockLibrary.cs:19-23) and opens that original file with ReadDwgFile OpenForReadAndAllShare into a process-wide cache (BlockLibraryDatabaseCache.cs:11-15, 17-56). No private copy is made and the Database is not supplied by the caller.
contract_required_operations.basis: Clause SL-5: reading ONLY an already-opened library Database of a private copy (outside T_M, under the lock, callee transactions allowed)

contract_required_operations.description: A definition with pieces missing from the drawing must not be reported as a normal success. Current CreateSystemBlock skips missing blocks (LateralHeaderDrawer.cs:293-303) and the product only prints them after placement (BlockPlacement.cs:44; RackCommandSupport.cs:195-205). AUTH-15 returns MissingLibraryBlocks and does not write the envelope (RackDefinitionCreator.cs:65-72). Whether a missing piece must fail the seam is not stated by the contract (UNCERTAIN); at minimum SL-5's structured result must carry it.
contract_required_operations.basis: Clause SL-5 structured result; clause: a failed call leaves the caller obliged to abort

contract_required_operations.description: On failure the seam returns a typed failure and the caller aborts T_M; the seam must not clean up. Current: ViewBlockDraw.DrawAndPlace converts exceptions to HeaderPlacementResult.Failure (ViewBlockDraw.cs:47-56); if PlaceBlockWithJig throws, PlaceAndReport returns Failure (BlockPlacement.cs:49-52) while the definition from T1 is ALREADY committed and is not erased (erase only on cancel, :37-42).
contract_required_operations.basis: Clause: a failed call leaves the caller obliged to abort

contract_required_operations.description: SL-6 expected-versus-persisted comparator with no write surface. No such component exists for Selective creation. Available read-only primitives: RackBlockData.Read (RackBlockData.cs:54-89), RackBlockFinder.ScanEnvelopes/FindFirstModelSpaceReference (RackBlockFinder.cs:20-31,57-65), RackSourcePlacementCaptureAdapter.Capture (Drawing/RackSourcePlacementCaptureAdapter.cs:13-39, reads Position/Rotation/ScaleFactors/Normal/definition Origin; no caller in src).
contract_required_operations.basis: Clause SL-6: read-only verifier and expected-versus-persisted comparator (no write surface)

contract_required_operations.category: no interaction / no side DB writes
contract_required_operations.description: No prompts or jigs inside T_M and no OpenCloseTransaction or side-database write in SL-1/2/4. Current chain prompts for fondo (RackSelectivoCommands.cs:499-515) and runs editor.Drag inside T2 (BlockPlacement.cs:183-184). The creation chain uses no StartOpenCloseTransaction (only LateralHeaderDrawService.cs:278, redraw path) and writes no side database (the library side DB is only read, BlockLibraryImporter.cs:103-115).
contract_required_operations.basis: Clause SL-4: no jig, no interaction; clauses SL-1/SL-2/SL-4: NO OpenCloseTransaction or side-database write

limitations: Sweep scope: only src/RackCad.Plugin references Autodesk assemblies (RackCad.Plugin.csproj:11-16,28-39); UI/Application/Domain were grepped for 'Autodesk.' with no source hits, so their code was read only to resolve names, ids and plan contents.

Grep-based: sites reached through delegates (Func plan/blockName in ViewBlockDraw.DrawAndPlace, PreparedDestination.Write in ProjectVariableMutationExecutor) were resolved by reading callers; no reflection or dynamic dispatch was found, but a call-graph tool was not used (method independence by design).

AutoCAD runtime semantics are not provable from source and are UNCERTAIN: the layer/properties a BlockReference receives when appended without SetDatabaseDefaults; whether WblockCloneObjects uses an internal transaction; the coordinate system of the jig's AcquirePoint value; IsDynamicBlock of the plain top-level definition; exact defaults of BlockReference Normal/Rotation/ScaleFactors.
Whether SelectiveDimensions/SelectiveAnnotations emit Dimension/Annotation instances for every configuration was not traced (OP-15/OP-17 marked conditional/PROBABLE).

Lateral corte creation (RackSelectivoCommands.cs:461-465, 535-592 -> LateralHeaderDrawService.DrawAndPlace/CreateBlock, LateralHeaderDrawService.cs:28-53,236-271) is excluded from operations because the contract covers frontal (SL-1) and planta (SL-2) only; it shares CreateSystemBlock, RackBlockData.Write and PlaceAndReport with the reached chain.

RackDefinitionCreator (AUTH-15) is described as it exists at 3375aadb; it has no product caller at this SHA and refuses a blank envelope Name (RackDefinitionCreator.cs:177-183). Later commits on main were not read.
No code was executed and no host (AutoCAD) evidence was produced; all claims are from static reading of the extract. ADRs in docs/adr were listed but not analysed.
Catalog loading (RackCatalogLoader.Load, RackCatalogLoader.cs:17-43) and user-settings reads (BlockLibrary.cs:21) are file I/O without AutoCAD database mutation and were not listed as operations.
